CompanySwitcher.description: Allows users to switch between multiple companies they have access to using a dropdown selector.

ariaLabel.description: Sets a custom aria-label for the company picker dropdown. Use to improve accessibility by providing descriptive text for screen readers, especially when the picker is embedded in contexts where the default label may not be clear.

onCompanyChange.description: Callback when the user selects a different company. Use to refresh page data, update application state, or trigger navigation when the company context changes.
